items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did Man of La Mancha with Richard Kiley the second time around.

ctx.x: Wow. So you really didn’t have much of a break at all.
No. And I did Man of La Mancha with Richard Kiley the second time around. I did that.
So that was what really kept you going in those years.
